cassette.name: Elian’s cassette
cassette.text: Two bells after a gull cry. “The sea is the long breathing. If I answer with your name, it is not me.” The leader bears your sister’s handwriting.

key.name: Intake key
key.text: An iron key stamped VISITOR. The reverse is deliberately blank.

lantern.name: Service lantern
lantern.text: A cold lantern from the market. Its empty reservoir takes the resin treatment described at the apothecary.

resin.name: Tested resin
resin.text: The blue-sealed mixture burns without smoke. Combine it with the service lantern.

protectedLantern.name: Treated lantern
protectedLantern.text: A steady amber flame. It slows exposure in the lower passages; it cannot make a voice truthful.

register.name: First Register
register.text: Two independent records verify June Arlen, Tomas Reed, Ada Wren and Niko Bell. Chosen aliases remain beside their names.

archive.name: Original shutoff order
archive.text: At 02:13 the oxygen supply was isolated. The signature and carbon impression match. This is physical evidence, not a voice.

relay.name: Relay contract
relay.text: Orison Recovery will carry the acoustic signal through municipal infrastructure. A transmission channel can also carry recorded testimony.

chalk.name: Survey chalk
chalk.text: Waterproof chalk supplied with a return-route diagram. Leave marks at physical junctions; do not follow voices.

core.name: Bell Core
core.text: The portable resonator contains a pattern formed from the erased records. It is a vessel, not another child.
